text.text_excerpt: I love this place. We go often, when we want to chill outside, and get great burgers and beer. Their burgers are always fantastic, and you can add really great toppings, like bleu cheese crumbles. Yum. The patio is cool in the summer, and they have heaters when it's cool. The service is outstanding, too.

This is a nice little underated spot with a good atmosphere and good food. I have been here two times total, and both times I've had a great time. I've sat in both the patio and at the bar, and both times the service was great. The employees are engaging, attentive, but not overly-so. Which is important to me when I want to enjoy the good company of a friend. Patios, courtyards and balconies are kind of my thing. I like to sit outside to eat/ drink if at all possible. GB's patio doesn't exactly have a fantastic view, but it is still a comfortable atmosphere. The wine list is limited, but acceptable. Pretty good wines at a pretty good price. If you've read any of my other reviews, you know...

I LOVE GB's! I lived in New Orleans for a year and this was the best little spot to go to any time during the week. The burgers are amazing and if you get it with the loaded baked potato on the side, it's even better! I have tried pretty much everything on their menu and I was never disappointed. Great drinks, great food, great atmosphere and great service. You get really lucky if Gerald bakes one of his awesome cakes as well. They are always delicious, I don't know why he doesn't open a bakery. The outdoor patio is perfect during any weather because it's covered and during the cold days they have outdoor heaters and ceiling fans are on during the summer. It's a comfortable place to go ha...
